tools.name: web
tools.description: Use when an agent needs to search the web: research, fact finding, finding official pages/docs, competitor or link discovery, grounding an answer with URLs. Returns ranked organic results (position, title, url, domain, snippet; published date or lastCrawled time when the source has one). The top 10

tools.name: news
tools.description: Use for current events, monitoring a company/person/topic in the press, finding recent coverage before answering, or building news digests. Returns up to 20 articles with title, direct article url (no redirect wrapper), publisher, published time (ISO 8601), snippet and image when available. sort=dat

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Use for keyword research, SEO/content ideas, query expansion before /v1/web or /v1/news, or guessing what people search for around a topic ("how to la" -> "how to lay tile", …). Returns the completions in source order. lang sets the suggestion language (en, de, fr, es, ja, …). Primary source Google'

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "news" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use for current events, monitoring a company/person/topic in the press, finding recent coverage before answering, or building news digests. Returns up to 20 art…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
